thread:
Tom (Finance): Heads-up: we're prepping a small pricing experiment to validate grandfathering logic for legacy customers. Goal: avoid surprising invoices while testing new per-token bands. Need ops checklist + gating signals.

Sasha (Billing): +1. Which cohorts are in scope? and will this be visible in the invoice CSV?

Tom (Finance): Starting with three cohorts: legacy-monthly, legacy-annual, and pilot-power-users (customers with >1M tokens/mo). We'll tag them via account metadata `pricing_cohort=v2-grandfather` so exports can filter.

Aisha (RevOps): What's the timeline and notification plan? We should run a dry-run billing reconciliation before any live cutover. Also need comms copy for affected customers. :loudspeaker:

Kai (Product): For the UI, we need to surface "grandfathered rate" on the billing page and in the API /billing endpoint response. Can we keep an explicit `rate_version` field so downstream teams can map behavior?

Carlos (Billing Ops): Important: proration rules. If someone on legacy-annual upgrades mid-cycle, we must not apply new rates until renewal unless they opt in. I'll add a guard in the invoicing job. Also: we should add a flag in metering pipeline to emit `grandfathered:true|false` so reconciliations are deterministic.

Tom (Finance): Agreed. Draft runbook checklist (quick):
```
- Create cohort tag + verify on test tenant
- Emit `grandfathered` flag from metering (stage)
- Run dry reconciliation on last 30 days (compare ledger + invoice preview)
- Validate invoice CSV format unchanged (column add ok)
- Canary 1% of legacy-monthly for 24h, monitor delta on invoice_preview_count and refunds
- Rollback plan + notif templates ready
```

Sasha (Billing): I'll own the invoice CSV schema check. Can we get the sample export by EOD so I can run diff?

Aisha (RevOps): I'll draft the customer email + in-product banner. Suggest holding off on public pricing page until we confirm no regressions.

BillingBot: Ticket created: FIN-3247 "grandfathering experiment - runbook + reconciliation" by Tom (Finance). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-3247

Kai (Product): One more ask — please include a small eval prompt set to check for increased usage from system messages; sometimes changes to batching/quantization shift counts.

Carlos (Billing Ops): Noted. I'll add a reconciliation job to compare token counts pre/post and flag >5% diff.

Tom (Finance): Great. Next steps: Sasha to post CSV diff by EOD, Carlos to instrument `grandfathered` emission in stage, Aisha to draft comms. We'll meet 11:30am tomorrow to approve the canary window. Thanks everyone. :tada:
